title: TeazerCharter
specs: Custom 35ft Maine built charter boat with 375hp Cat diesel engine
Captain Pete Morse has 20+ years sea experience and holds 100-ton USCG Captain license
No fishing license required; covered under the boat's license
No stated age or weight limits
Boat comfortably fishes up to 6 people
includes: Rods, tackle and filleting of fish included
blurb: Guests fish for Giant Bluefin Tuna, Striped Bass, Cod, Haddock, Sharks, Bluefish and more on a custom 35ft Maine built charter boat. The boat is powered by a 375hp Cat diesel and comfortably fishes up to 6 people. Captain Pete Morse holds a 100-ton US Coast Guard Captain and Registered Master Maine Tidewater Guide Licenses.
extraNote: $200 deposit required to hold trip · If captain cancels due to unsafe conditions, reschedule or deposit refund offered · Alcohol allowed in limited quantities; no hard alcohol or glass bottles · Meet at Southport Marine in So. Portland, Maine at the picnic table/flagpole area. Parking for one vehicle in the lot; additional vehicles on "A" Street or surrounding side streets.
